title: fix(plugin-detail): on a desktop the enlarged related tab draws the child object's list grid
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbC5yRMtRXouSfKD16A2gwFn)_

Fixes #28865

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页放大的相关列表页签，在桌面端改为渲染子对象列表页同款的 `object-grid`（手机端自 #28484 起已是如此），不再是通用 `data-table`。行高、密度、名称链接、行操作都与列表页一致；全部芯片已显示数量时，工具栏下方不再重复显示「N 条」。
- **为什么改**：#27524 第 9 项规定放大页签就是「子对象的列表面」；实测桌面端行高约 65 px（列表页 41 px）、名称是纯文本点不开、数量显示两次。
- **风险与回滚**：中低。分页、排序仍由相关列表自己掌控（服务端 `$top/$skip/$orderby` 不变），通过 grid 的宿主属性传入；行操作仍经宿主的 `onRowAction` 派发到子对象。唯一行为差异：筛选框有文字时，查找类列的表头不再提供排序（与所有列表页一致）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 的 `viewSchema` 放大分支与 `enlargedGridHost`；② 同文件 `enlargedGridActions`（把 grid 的行操作派发路由回宿主）；③ 新测试 `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm` 后打开 客户 Acme Corp → 商机列表 页签（1440 px）：行高与商机列表页相同，名称是蓝色链接、点开即打开记录抽屉，数量只在「全部 4」芯片上出现一次。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`RelatedList`'s enlarged face (the record page's active related tab) now renders `object-grid` on every width, the branch the phone has taken since #28484. On a desktop it fell through to the generic `data-table`.

- **One branch, phone and desktop.** `viewSchema` returns `object-grid` over the page of rows this list already read (`data: { provider: 'value', items }`), with the list's columns, the grid's own pager and search off (`showPagination: false`, `showSearch: false`). Under 768 px the grid draws the phone list's card rows, as before.
- **The list stays the source of truth.** Its window, page and sort reach the grid on the grid's host channel: React props spread on `SchemaRenderer` (`manualPagination`, `rowCount`, `page`, `pageSize`, `onPageChange`, `sort`, `onSortChange`), the same ones `plugin-list`'s `ListView` hands the grid. Paging and sort stay the server's `$top` / `$skip` / `$orderby`; the list's own pager stays the one pager, because it also answers a window whose total the server did not send (`hasMore`). `objectFields` rides along so no column paints withheld while the grid reads the definition (objectui#10657).
- **Row actions come from the grid.** The host's localized row actions (`list_item`, and `record_related` inside a parent record) ride to the grid's row menu as `rowActionDefs`, the non-author host key the console's object page uses. Row Edit is the host's `onRowEdit`; row Delete is this list's confirm-then-delete.
- **Row-action dispatch stays the host's.** The grid runs a row action def through the surrounding action runner with the row under `params._rowRecord` and no object of its own; on the record page that runner's object is the parent's, and nothing would tell the list to read its rows again. `RelatedList` provides the grid an action context (`enlargedGridActions`) that sends a dispatch carrying one of its own row action defs and a row to the host's `onRowAction` (child object, row context, and the related-changed signal that refetches the list), and every other dispatch to the surrounding runner unchanged.
- **One count.** While the 全部 chip is on and nothing narrows the rows, the line under the toolbar no longer repeats the chip's count; it keeps the page line when there is one. A narrowing chip (我的 / 逾期) or filter text keeps the line's count, which is then a different number.
- Compact panels in the right column and lists that are not enlarged are unchanged. No change to `plugin-grid`.

## Why

#27524 item 9: the enlarged tab is "the full-width table (all columns, paging, sort, inline edit where the FK allows — **the child object's list face**)". Measured on `main` before this PR (account Acme Corp → 商机, 1440 px, `examples/app-crm`): rows 65 px against the opportunity list page's 41 px, the name as plain text, and the count shown twice (「全部 4」 and 「4 条」).

## Tests

- New `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx` (11 tests): the desktop branch is `object-grid` over the read rows with the grid's pager and search off; the host channel carries the window, page and sort and none of it rides as node keys; a header sort from the grid becomes one server `$orderby` from page 1; a page from the grid reads the next window (`$skip` 25); the pinned deviation below; the count shows once on 全部 and a narrowing chip keeps its own count; a grid row-action dispatch reaches `onRowAction` with the def and the row, and (control) any other dispatch does not; row Edit is the host's and row Delete asks first; control: a list that is not enlarged keeps the `data-table` with no host props.
- `RelatedList.enlargedPhoneCards-28484.test.tsx`: its desktop control now asserts the same `object-grid` branch.
- `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx`: registers a stand-in `object-grid` (this package cannot import `plugin-grid`, which depends on it) and asserts the status line is not drawn when the 全部 chip carries the count.
- `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.childWriteRefreshesParent-12244.test.tsx`: the enlarged tab's row menu is now the grid's, so the test opens it by `row-action-trigger`. The delete still re-reads the parent.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to `HEAD` byte-identical):
- desktop branch gated back to the phone (`enlargedFace && isMobile && …`): 7 of 11 red in the new file;
- the routed dispatch sent to the surrounding runner instead of `onRowAction`: 1 red (the routing test);
- the one-count rule switched off: 2 red (the new count test and the 27524 toolbar test).

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation (pinned):** while the filter box has text the list sorts its in-memory rows itself; the grid is still handed that sort on the host channel, and under a host sort the grid offers no header sort on a relational column (its stored value is an id), as on every list page. The `data-table` sorted such a column by its label in that one state. Pinned in the new test file.
- Screenshots (1440 px, zh-CN, `examples/app-crm`, fresh boot) are in the project folder `issue-28865/`; the seat links them here: `before-account-opportunities-1440.png`, `after-account-opportunities-1440.png`, and for comparison `opportunity-list-page-1440.png`; also `after-name-opens-record-1440.png`, `after-sorted-amount-desc-1440.png`, `after-leads-row-actions-1440.png` and the phone face `after-account-opportunities-390.png`.
- Measured in the running app after the change: rows 41 px on the tab and on the list page; a header click sends `sort=amount` then `amount desc` and the rows follow; the name opens the record drawer stepping 1 / 4; the 全部 chip says 4 and no line repeats it; on the leads tab the row menu holds 编辑, 删除 and Convert Lead, and Convert Lead posts `actions/crm_lead/crm_convert_lead` and the list then re-reads `crm_lead`.
- The 操作 header over a column with no visible buttons is the grid's own behaviour, the same as on the list page (#28871); it is not changed here.

## Verification

At head `47c53a5a` (this branch with `origin/main` `7fa9873f` merged in; 4 later commits on main touch none of the changed files):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` (from `ui/`, `--maxWorkers=2`, under `os-verify-lock`): 361 files passed, 1 skipped; 3200 tests passed, 18 skipped (run before the main merge; the merge touched no file under `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid` or `react`).
- 30 `app-shell` / `console` / `plugin-view` / `plugin-grid` test files that name `RelatedList`, the enlarged face or `?related=`: 30 / 30 files, 496 / 496 tests after the row-menu update above.
- The touched test files again at the final head: the three `plugin-detail` files plus the 30 above, 33 / 33 files, 516 / 516 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check`: exit 0. `eslint` on `RelatedList.tsx`: 0 errors, 99 warnings, the same count as `main`.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 34 commands, run at `47c53a5a`): 34 / 34 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every line with its exit code); `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` exit 0. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0 (manifest present and intact, 106 components).
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` with this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`: exit 0 (`Metadata-protocol: none`, patch); `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword` on this body: exit 0.
